title: Shared Authoritative Timeline Core
externalChecks: Gate E real-device unsynchronized drift calibration remains EXTERNAL VALIDATION PENDING; Gate F may proceed, but no drift threshold becomes final until that experiment is completed
instructions: Implement only pure shared synchronization protocol/types and timeline math. No server room store, Socket.IO handlers, browser player control, clock estimator, chat, persistence, or UI changes.
The timeline must be server-authoritative and project from an anchor media time plus elapsed server time only when playing.
Future stampedAtServerMs values must never project backwards: elapsed time must clamp at zero.
Timeline ordering must compare roomEpoch first, then seq, and equal versions are stale/duplicate rather than new.
Participant identity must use participantId/clientId/socket identity separation; do not reintroduce a fake account userId.
Readiness must remain split into userArmed and mediaReady.
Playback intents must be discriminated unions; seek requires targetSeconds while play/pause do not.
Playback intents must fence to movieId + assetId + assetVersion + roomEpoch and include cmdId + observedSeq.
Do not choose or encode final drift-correction thresholds in this gate. Gate E calibration is still pending.
A task is not complete until pnpm watch:gate exits 0 and the GitHub Watch Together Gate is green.
After Gate F passes, stop. Do not begin Gate G room-store work in the same branch.
